Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.utility

Class DragCoordinateCalculator

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.internal.utility.DragCoordinateCalculator
@Component public class DragCoordinateCalculator extends Object
Provides drag-and-drop functionality between locations with configurable timing and mock support.

This wrapper abstracts Sikuli's drag-and-drop operations, enabling controlled dragging from one Location to another. It supports fine-grained timing control at each stage of the drag operation (mouse down, drag movement, mouse up) to ensure compatibility with various applications that may have different responsiveness requirements.

The class integrates with Brobot's action system to provide:

  • Configurable delays at each drag stage via ActionConfig
  • Mock support for testing without actual mouse movements
  • Detailed reporting of drag operations and failures

Typical timing recommendations for reliable drag operations:

  • PauseBeforeMouseDown: 0.3s - Allow UI to settle before starting
  • PauseAfterMouseDown: 0.3s - Ensure drag is recognized
  • MoveMouseDelay: 0.5s - Control drag speed
  • PauseBeforeMouseUp: 0.4s - Allow drop target to activate
  • PauseAfterMouseUp: 0.0s - Usually no delay needed

  • Method Details

    • drag

      public boolean drag(Location from, Location to, DragOptions dragOptions)
      Executes a drag-and-drop operation using DragOptions configuration.

      This method performs a complete drag-and-drop sequence using the new ActionConfig API. It extracts timing parameters from the DragOptions and its contained MousePressOptions.

      Parameters:
      from - The starting location for the drag. Must not be null.
      to - The destination location for the drag. Must not be null.
      dragOptions - Configuration containing timing and mouse button settings.
      Returns:
      true if the drag completed successfully (or was mocked), false if the drag operation failed.

    • drag

      public boolean drag(Location from, Location to, ActionConfig actionConfig)
      Executes a drag-and-drop operation using ActionConfig.

      This method provides support for ActionConfig types. Currently only DragOptions is supported as ActionConfig doesn't extend ActionConfig.

      Parameters:
      from - The starting location for the drag.
      to - The destination location for the drag.
      actionConfig - Configuration for the drag operation.
      Returns:
      true if the drag completed successfully, false otherwise.
